title: Finish My Drawing · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Finish My Drawing · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: One player chooses an object and draws two distinctive features. A partner adds up to three strokes without being told the object. The group identifies the object the first player intended. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Finish My Drawing, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group identifies the object the first player intended.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group identifies the object the first player intended.
